release.trigger: Candidate is ready for a release decision.
steps: Collect report files and their digests for this candidate.
Run release ops promote with the dossier and a new output path.
Advance the ring only after its new health evidence has passed.
release.verification: Check the candidate digest and every named signoff in the saved record.
release.rollback: Halt the ring; prepare a higher-version correction.

steps: Save the failing aggregate measurements.
Set the ring to halted and publish a zero offer fraction.
Remove its offer and stop distribution kit jobs.
halt.verification: A test device receives no offer; a kit job refuses this version.
halt.rollback: Resume only with a recorded reason and a restarted soak.

steps: Prepare a new entry id and incident reference.
Submit the per-channel file to OperationsPublisher with the service gate runner.
Carry the returned signed file in the next kit and verify the next-turn effect offline.
safety_configuration.verification: The target is denied and an unrelated target remains usable.
safety_configuration.rollback: Ship the fixed artefact that satisfies the entry lift condition.

content_correction.trigger: A content report has been confirmed.
steps: Open a durable HotfixStore case and record the withdrawal entry.
Create a replacement item with a new id and a checked patch.
Use the learner replay execution port and save its evidence digest.
content_correction.verification: The old id is absent from presented content; replay changes only superseding verdicts.
content_correction.rollback: Keep the withdrawal active while a replacement is checked.

skill_pin.trigger: A shipped skill is teaching incorrectly.
steps: Find a previous signed bundle containing a reviewed version.
Publish a skill restriction and confirm the selected version and hash in a turn trace.
Build a corrected bundle for each supported app minor.
skill_pin.verification: The new turn loads the previous skill, or omits it when none verifies.
skill_pin.rollback: Disable the skill while its correction is prepared.

model_withdrawal.trigger: A model fails a field safety or correctness gate.
steps: Withdraw the model in the matrix and publish its disable entry.
Check an installed fallback, then repeat with no allowed model.
Require a new bake-off and release gates before replacement.
model_withdrawal.verification: Lessons and practice open while the router skips the model.

signing_compromise.trigger: A signing credential may have escaped custody.
steps: Preserve the minimum incident audit and isolate the signer.
Use the existing root-signed revocation procedure.
Verify a replacement release and emergency kit on offline reference devices.
signing_compromise.verification: A device holding the new revocation list refuses the affected key.
signing_compromise.rollback: Do not restore a compromised credential; rotate and reissue affected artefacts.

child_safety.trigger: A category report indicates possible harm.
steps: Open SEV1 and record the Safety lead handoff.
Choose a containment path and registered adult contact.
Use only authorised evidence and record its deletion at closure.
child_safety.verification: The tabletop record contains handoff timing and the containment evidence.
child_safety.rollback: Maintain containment and escalate overdue actions to the commander.

data_breach.trigger: An incident may expose student data.
steps: Open SEV1 with a limited evidence group.
Contain the access path and preserve category counts.
Have the Safety lead record the required notification decision.
data_breach.verification: Test access is denied and the incident has a dated notification decision.
data_breach.rollback: Keep the affected path disabled until verified.

cloud_failover.trigger: Provider probes exceed the configured health limit.
steps: Check the qualified fallback configuration and synthetic probe history.
Fail the primary in staging and inspect the selected provider.
Recover it and observe the full healthy interval.
cloud_failover.verification: Requests use the fallback, then return only after the healthy interval.
cloud_failover.rollback: Disable the cloud path so the device can continue locally.

cloud_switch.trigger: A cloud path needs immediate containment.
steps: Use the authenticated operations switch with actor, reason and incident.
Send a synthetic new request and check provider_unavailable.
Check that no provider received that request.
cloud_switch.verification: The operations audit contains the change and the request made no upstream call.
cloud_switch.rollback: Enable only through another audited decision after containment verification.

cost_spike.trigger: A grouped daily cost alert fires.
steps: Review provider, model, role and licence aggregates.
Compare token counts with the registered price table.
Record a billing-assumption review and choose a quota or switch action.
cost_spike.verification: A synthetic spike produces one same-day alert without prompt content.
cost_spike.rollback: Contain optional cloud use while keeping local learning available.

steps: Fetch a known artefact through the verified secondary-origin path.
Build a distribution kit from the stable R3 inventory.
Record the physical samples before recording school dispatch.
origin_usb.verification: Bytes and signatures match, and the physical sample records pass.
origin_usb.rollback: Use the last verified kit; do not distribute a candidate kit.

steps: Use the offered local rollback on the reference device.
Save a metadata-only support report.
Prepare the corrected signed update and record the school kit version.
school_update.verification: The previous installation opens the same retained learning data.
school_update.rollback: Keep the working installation until a verified correction is available.

steps: Check the service metadata and open the incident.
Verify that the free offline product opens.
Record registered-contact guidance and the recovery check.
checkout.verification: Local lessons remain usable without any activation action.
checkout.rollback: Disable the affected optional online path until recovered.
